newsitem.title: USA: TVA Sequoyah 1 power unit at 100 pct power.
newsitem.headline: TVA Sequoyah 1 power unit at 100 pct power.

text.p: TVA Nuclear's 1,148 megawatt (MW) Sequoyah 1 nuclear unit in Soddy-Daisy, Tenn., is operating at full power Thursday following an outage over the weekend, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
On Tuesday, the unit was holding at 55 percent power so a second main feedwater pump could be placed in service, the NRC said.
TVA Nuclear is a unit of the Tennessee Valley Authority, a federal agency that produces and markets electricity.
